g.title: One path, many shapes
g.desc: Shape morphing across 6 forms that share no path-command structure (star, circle, heart, bolt, drop, cross). Each path is flattened, resampled by arc length and re-emitted as one uniform M + C + Z signature, which is the only form SMIL interpolates. No library and no JavaScript, so it runs inside a README image.
